about: Reviewed footprint-only covers links (pands a model's footprint covers that its suppressOsmIds do not hide). 'hide': the pand is part of the model's structure, covers.json lists it and ?bagTiles=1 hides it. 'keep': the pand is a neighbour or outbuilding, covers.json omits it and it stays drawn. A footprint-only pand with no decision here is a hidden bug: check:covers --strict fails until someone decides. Rule of thumb used on 2026-10-13 (docs/buildings-pipeline.md, BAG tiles): the model footprint is a dilated GLB occupancy raster (about 4 m cells), so a share under 0.8 (the check:osm-under-models standard) of a terrace-width pand is a neighbour; a pand under 25 m2 whose centroid is under the footprint is an appurtenance (buttress, porch) of the host. Review plots: scripts/review-covers-plots.ts.
